ko.title: 2026 베이징 마라톤 개최…2시간 3분 10초 새 대회 기록

en.title: 2026 Beijing Marathon held; new course record of 2:03:10
en.summary: The 2026 Beijing Marathon was held, producing a new course record of 2 hours 3 minutes 10 seconds. More than 70% of participants came from outside Beijing.
